mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates a supply shock that disrupts corporate production and supply chains, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by rising employment levels, supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 850,000 units signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 850.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPI) and the federal funds rate signal a monetary tightening cycle that raises real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), the central bank's response of raising interest rates compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.
